mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.goods_id, g.title AS goodsTitle, g.images AS goodsImages, r.rater_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS raterName, u.avatar AS raterAvatar, r.ratee_id, r.score, r.content, r.create_time FROM review r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.rater_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = r.goods_id WHERE r.ratee_id = #{rateeId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS goodCount FROM review WHERE ratee_id = #{rateeId}
